title: CLTR Cutover shared typed authority enums
description: The 7 shared cross-family enums frozen by CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.8.1-8.7, plus one additional shared nomenclature enum (record_family) needed for reference-family tagging (Sec.12). Unknown-value behavior is reject (fail closed) for every enum here; no alias, case-fold, or substring match is ever permitted. Defining record_family does not create, instantiate, or authorize any of the 16 named record schemas -- it only names the closed vocabulary a future record_reference.record_family field may claim (CSCH-EXEC-REQ-030). The 14 family-local enums (RequestState, ReadinessState, AuthorizationState, CandidateState, CertificationState, GateResult, PublicationOutcome, ConflictType, JournalState, ReconciliationState, QuarantineState, DeliveryState, MarkerState, ReceiptState) are deliberately NOT centralized here; each is scoped to its own owning family's future schema file (Sec.8.8).

authority_kind.description: AuthorityKind (Sec.8.1). Unknown-value behavior: reject. No version-extension behavior in v1.0.

authority_role.description: AuthorityRole (Sec.8.2), the Stage-3 companion 7-value vocabulary. Shares zero code points with CLTR-SCHEMA-001's 5-code (S/R/D/E/V) authority_role field. The 'authoritative' value is restricted at the record-schema level (Sec.9) to authority_state.schema.json and publication_evidence.schema.json only -- this shared enum definition alone does not enforce that restriction; no record schema exists yet in this phase to carry it.

migration_stage.description: MigrationStage (Sec.8.3), the Stage-3 typed 11-value migration stage. Distinct from src/pcae/cltr/migration/enums.py's existing 6-value MigrationStage class; the two must never be conflated.

recovery_state.description: RecoveryState (Sec.8.6), the Stage-3 typed 10-value recovery state -- a superset, not a synonym, of the existing 4-value RecoveryClassification in src/pcae/cltr/enums.py, and entirely distinct from the already-implemented 11-value RecoveryState in src/pcae/cltr/migration/rehearsal/enums.py (Stage 2). All three enums are real and simultaneously valid in this codebase; no code may substitute one for another.

compatibility_mode.description: CompatibilityMode (Sec.8.7), 6 values, forward-only documented ordering: legacy_authoritative -> legacy_adapter -> legacy_read_only -> legacy_historical -> legacy_disabled -> legacy_retired. This ordering is advisory documentation only; JSON Schema cannot enforce state-machine transition ordering across documents (Layer 4).

record_family.description: Closed nomenclature for the record_family tag on shared/references.schema.json#/$defs/record_reference (CSCH-EXEC-REQ-030). Exactly the 16 standalone companion family slugs frozen by CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.4. Naming a family here does not create, instantiate, or authorize its schema file -- none of the 16 named record schemas exists yet; this phase implements shared-core definitions only.
